title: ID0472211-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/S9 170004040] Plug 1 is unavailable
description: Reported behavior/issue: Plug 1 is unavailable. A false cable theft report is being received, along with an error on Mainbreaker_QA1

additional_info.subject: T-00210010 // Ladepark Duisburg HPC2: Plug 1 Error // Ladepark Duisburg, Beecker Str. 51, 47166 Duisburg // MP/S9 170004040
additional_info.body:
Dear all,
Would you be so kind to have a look at charger MP/S9 170004040?
We see that,
Plug 1 ist nicht verfügbar. Es wird ein falscher Kabeldiebstahl gemeldet sowie ein Error an Mainbreaker_QA1, der von uns vor Ort selber nich behoben werden kann. Bitte um Entstörung vor Ort innerhalb der gebuchten SLAs. Es ist ein eigenes Schloss verbaut. Der Schlüssel kann in Essen (Alfredstr. 81) nach vorheriger Terminvereinbarung abgeholt werden. Vielen Dank!
.
We would kindly ask to provide a brief feedback via
operations.de@edri.com
.
Please send only one mail per charger and the same subject title to ensure efficient handling.
Thanks in advance and best regards
Team Operations DE

additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0472211
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: EON
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / S9 170004040
Charger ID / Serial No.:
T23aFI
Charger address/functional location: Germany
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Cable sensor temperature
Please measure on-site and confirm the values by measuring directly on the cables coming from the CCS. If you see the same value, then the CCS is faulty and needs replacement. Otherwise, please measure 1kOhm until you reach the KF12/ KF14
P1 to P2 and N1 to N2
If you get 1kOhm to the StateMonitor, please try replacing the grey connector with a spare one (they have some connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all)
Or replace the StateMonitor
I recommend you to take spare CCS and StateMonitor
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
